__comment: Immich, a self-hosted photo server. No OAuth: the customUI app com.palm.app.immich-auth collects the server's address and an API key the user made in Immich, and calls com.palm.service.immich/login, which checks them (/server/version, then /users/me) and returns the stored credentials. A PHOTO source only - no DOCUMENTS capability, no files app.
__comment2: com.palm.app.immich-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists.
__comment3: com.palm.service.immich is in read+writePermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) for the photo-provider calls. An API key does not expire, so writeCredentials is unused after create (kept for symmetry).

capabilityProviders.__comment: Makes the Immich account a photo source. implementation/hooks point at the stock Photos AGGREGATOR (com.palm.service.photos), which discovers PHOTO.UPLOAD accounts and (its service name derived from the templateId) calls com.palm.service.immich/listAlbums+listPhotos and downloads each photo from the URL listPhotos gives (the API key in it as ?apiKey=).
